title: 第408章 怀了，还是双胎！
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

方安雅弯下腰把小花抱起来，“哎呦，外婆也想你呢。这不，外婆搬过来陪你住一段时间好不好？”

“真的吗？”小花搂着方安雅的脖子不撒手，“好耶好耶！那外婆我可以跟你睡一张床吗？我保证我不打呼噜，也不踢被子！”

方安雅被逗得眉开眼笑：“当然可以啦。不过，你每天必须要完成外婆布置的作业才行。”

小花的小脸立马垮了下来，“啊……我还没上小学呢，怎么就有作业啊？”

“你现在提前学了，等你去上小学的时候，不就把所有小朋友都比下去了吗？到时候你就是全班第一名，老师最喜欢你，同学们都羡慕你。”

小花眼珠子骨碌碌转了几圈，好像有道理哈。

她挺起小胸脯：“好！我要当第一名！”

见小花三两下就被方安雅忽悠住了，林见微和厉小棠都忍不住笑了起来。

厉小棠在旁边啧啧称奇：“婶子，你来了正好。这小妞现在精得很，我有时候都拿捏不住她了。”

小花听懂了这是在说她，扭过头不服气地喊：“我才没有呢！”

“好好好，没有没有。”厉小棠笑着摆手，“快带外婆进去吧，把咱们刚刚买的桃子洗了给外婆吃。”

“好嘞！外婆快进来！”

小花拉着方安雅的手，噔噔噔地往屋里跑。

方安雅被她拽着，脚步踉踉跄跄的，脸上的笑却没断过。

进了屋，小花搬了个小板凳，踩上去够水龙头，认认真真地洗桃子，洗了一个最大的，举着湿漉漉的手递给方安雅。

“外婆，你吃。”

方安雅心里头暖洋洋的，接过来咬了一口，甜得眯起了眼。

还是人多热闹好啊。

也不知道老头子一个人在沙漠那边过得好不好。

哎呀，肯定不好，沙漠能有啥好的。

方安雅心里想，等过阵子天气再热些，得让微微给老林寄点东西过去。

日子一天天地过着。

林见微白天去武研所跟那群老顽固扯皮。

说“扯皮”其实也不太准确。

经过那次航母方案讨论会之后，郑国基、邢龙济那几个人对她的态度来了个一百八十度的大转弯。

现在每天追在她屁股后面问这问那。

林见微嘴上嫌他们烦，但教起来还是尽心尽力的。

毕竟这些人都是国内航母领域最顶尖的人才，把他们带出来了，以后航母的事就不用她一个人扛了。

晚上回到家，她就被满满的爱包围着。

方安雅和厉小棠知道她在备孕，什么活儿都不让她干，碗不让洗，地不让拖，衣服不让晾，就差把饭喂到她嘴边了。

Fang Anya bent down and picked up Xiaohua, "Oh, grandma misses you too. How about grandma move here to live with you for a while?"

"Really?" Xiaohua hugged Fang Anya's neck and refused to let go, "Yes, yes! Then grandma, can I sleep in the same bed with you? I promise I won't snore or kick the quilt!"

Fang Anya was amused and beamed: "Of course you can. However, you must complete the homework assigned by grandma every day."

Xiaohua's little face immediately fell, "Ah... I haven't gone to elementary school yet, why do I have homework?"

"Now that you are studying ahead of time, won't you be able to outperform all the children when you go to elementary school? By then you will be number one in the class, the teacher will like you the most, and your classmates will envy you."

The little flower's eyes rolled around a few times, which seemed to make sense.

She puffed up her breasts and said, "Okay! I want to be the first!"

Seeing that Xiaohua was fooled by Fang Anya in just a few seconds, Lin Jianwei and Li Xiaotang couldn't help laughing.

Li Xiaotang marveled at her from the side: "Auntie, you came just in time. This girl is so good now that I can't handle her sometimes."

Xiaohua understood that this was talking about her, turned her head and shouted unconvinced: "I don't have one!"

"Okay, okay, no, no, no." Li Xiaotang smiled and waved, "Bring grandma in quickly and wash the peaches we just bought for grandma to eat."

"Okay! Grandma, come in quickly!"

Xiaohua took Fang Anya's hand and ran towards the house.

Fang Anya was dragged by her, her steps staggering, but the smile on her face did not break.

After entering the house, Xiaohua moved a small bench, stepped on it to reach the faucet, washed the peaches seriously, washed the largest one, and handed it to Fang Anya with her wet hands.

"Grandma, you eat."

Fang Anya felt warm in her heart, so she took a bite and narrowed her eyes because of the sweetness.

It's better to have more people and more excitement.

I don’t know if the old man can live well alone in the desert.

Oops, it's definitely not good. What good can a desert do?

Fang Anya thought to herself that when the weather gets warmer in a while, Weiwei will have to send something to Lao Lin.

The days passed day by day.

Lin Jianwei went to the Wuhan Research Institute to argue with those old stubborns during the day.

To say "wrangling" is actually not quite accurate.

After that aircraft carrier plan discussion meeting, Zheng Guoji and Xing Longji made a 180-degree turn in their attitude towards her.

Now I'm chasing after her every day asking this and that.

Lin Jianwei said that they were annoying, but he still tried his best to teach them.

After all, these people are the top talents in the field of domestic aircraft carriers. By bringing them out, she will not have to handle the aircraft carrier affairs alone in the future.

When she got home at night, she was surrounded by love.

Fang Anya and Li Xiaotang knew that she was preparing for pregnancy, so they didn't let her do any work. They didn't let her wash the dishes, mop the floor, or dry the clothes. They just put food in her mouth.
